title: Hall's universal group does not have finite big Ramsey degrees
summary: In this paper we show that the Hall's universal group does not have finite big Ramsey degrees. Our strategy consists of piggybacking on the recent result of Hubička, Konečný, Todorčević and Zucker (announced at EUROCOMB 2025) that the random edge-labelled graph (the Fraïssé limit of the class of all finite complete edge-labelled graphs where the set of labels is countably infinite) does not have finite big Ramsey degrees.
